outputIntent: Render only the supplied nodes, clusters, and typed edges as an editorial map with one immediately legible focal relationship.
positioning: Not decorative network art or an inferred fandom chart; it is a faithful information visualization whose semantics can be audited edge by edge.
contentSchema: explicit directed or undirected typed edges

layoutFamilies.topology: two or three soft containment fields orbit a focal node pair; edges route around label zones and enter node frames at distinct ports
layoutFamilies.readingPath: focus pair -> cluster membership -> typed edges -> legend
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: orthographic editorial map with one focal node scale and one supporting node scale
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: all supplied nodes for the page, all supplied edges, two or three clusters, one legend

layoutFamilies.topology: two opposing or sequential anchors define a strong axis; secondary nodes attach on perimeter lanes; the highlighted edge owns the center
layoutFamilies.readingPath: anchor A -> focal edge -> anchor B -> supporting feedback
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: wide diagram view with generous central whitespace and perimeter edge routing
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: two anchors, supplied supporting nodes, exact focal edge set, one compact legend

physicalVisualSystem.material: restrained editorial vector print with soft paper grain, uniform node frames, precise edge ports, and subtle containment fields
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: flat print light with minimal depth; no 3D globes or glowing cyber lines
physicalVisualSystem.color: ivory ground, graphite nodes, one neutral frame accent, fixed semantic edge colors only
physicalVisualSystem.typography: compact Chinese node labels and legend keys with consistent weights and no auto-generated captions

qcAssertions: every expected edge appears once with correct type and direction
map remains readable at phone size and above the safe band
